jobs.description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for an experienced writer to develop data-backed theses and original content pieces about how startups and AI-native businesses launch, monetize, and grow. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with contributors across the product marketing, product, engineering, and demand generation teams to produce compelling content that engages and informs our audience. This is a unique opportunity for a collaborative writer and content producer who excels at translating complex concepts in AI, billing infrastructure, and revenue growth into accessible insights.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own content covering revenue strategies and pricing models, startups, and new developments in AI, working closely with product marketing to ensure our content reflects the latest industry advances and product news</li> <li>Coordinate with the demand generation team to identify opportunities for new editorial series and research agendas&nbsp;</li> <li>Pioneer new content formats for Stripe, including short-form content and multimedia projects that grow our audience</li> <li>Partner with the data science team and third-party agencies to surface relevant insights for existing and potential customers</li> <li>Ensure consistency and tone in messaging across Stripe channels, including blogs, guides, reports, and social-native content</li> <li>Manage a pipeline of content, ensuring clear communication and visibility across the organization</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. At Databricks, we do this every day.</p> <p>As a Digital Native Account Executive at Databricks, you come with relevant experience selling to Digital Native accounts.&nbsp; As a successful candidate, you are a self-starter who understands the sales process.
